plan.summary: Recovery-focused week after last week's 17.6 km long run and volleyball. Monday is absolute rest. Progressive build through the week towards a 19 km long run on Sunday at strict 6:30/km pace.

sessions.description: Absolute rest — no running, no gym. Full 24-hour shutdown to repair micro-tears from volleyball and 17.6 km effort.
Recovery run 6 km at 7:00-7:30/km (dog jog pace) + Gym Legs. Flush out lactic acid. Don't go to failure on squats/lunges.
Gym — Chest + Triceps. Let legs recover from Tuesday's gym while keeping upper body progression.
Threshold session — 6.5 km total: 1 km warm-up (6:30/km), 4.5 km at 4:45-4:55/km, 1 km cool-down (6:30/km). Stretch the threshold engine.
Recovery run 5 km at 7:00-7:30/km (dog jog) + Gym Back + Biceps. Prevent legs from locking up after Thursday's speed session.
Gym — Shoulders + Abs. Zero leg stress. Focus on planks and core stability to prepare chassis for Sunday.
Long run — 19 km at 6:30/km. Adding ~1.5 km to distance. MUST respect 6:30/km pace — running faster will drain CNS for the entire following week.
